videos.title: This is possibly my favorite Neovim and Rails config
videos.description: This video details configuring Neovim for Ruby on Rails development. It covers building a setup from scratch, utilizing lazy.nvim and Lua for plugin management, and demonstrates committing code within this environment.

videos.title: Ruby on Rails Tutorial - Install Ruby On Rails on Windows 10
videos.description: This video provides instructions on installing Ruby on Rails on Windows 10. It covers setting up the development framework for web applications, which utilizes the Ruby programming language.

videos.title: Ruby vs Python: DHH on why Ruby is better | Lex Fridman Podcast Clips
videos.description: This video discusses David Heinemeier Hansson's perspective on Ruby, comparing its advantages over Python. It features DHH, creator of Ruby on Rails, elaborating on his views about these programming languages.

videos.title: Setup A Ruby on Rails 7 API With React JS
videos.description: This video demonstrates setting up a Ruby on Rails 7 API with React JS. It covers creating the API and React app, accessing Rails JSON data from JavaScript using Axios, and rendering that data within React.

videos.title: The Untold Story of Ruby
videos.description: This video chronicles the history of the Ruby programming language, from its creation by Yukihiro Matsumoto to the development of the Ruby on Rails framework. It covers the language's initial reception, periods of significant growth and backlash, and its current status.
